title: Migration & Transfer — DMS + S3 staging for database moves
topic: AWS DMS full load + CDC, homogeneous vs heterogeneous (SCT), DMS Serverless, DynamoDB export/import via S3, DataSync vs Snowball vs Transfer Family vs MGN, Night 19 backup + DMS delta cutover
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-20-dms-s3-migration.md and night-20-lab-migration-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-20-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Legacy on-prem Oracle resort_stats must move to Aurora PostgreSQL with minimal write downtime during cutover. Which AWS pair handles schema conversion and ongoing replication?

options.A: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) for DDL + AWS DMS full load and CDC
options.B: AWS DataSync for schema conversion + AWS Backup for CDC replication
options.C: AWS Snowball Edge for DDL export + RDS snapshot export for CDC for this workload
options.D: AWS Transfer Family SFTP upload + DynamoDB import path for CDC for this workload

questions.question: After DMS full load completes on Postgres→Aurora, production still writes to the source for six hours before cutover. Which DMS task mode keeps the target current?

options.B: Full load + CDC — transaction logs continue after the initial copy
options.A: Full load only — no further replication after the initial table copy
options.C: CDC only — assumes the target already holds every historical row
options.D: S3 export only — DynamoDB JSON staging replaces CDC for Postgres

questions.question: A ski-resort NAS holds 600 TB of video. The data center link is 500 Mbps and leadership wants offline transfer. Best primary service?

options.C: AWS Snowball Edge or Snowball device shipment for offline bulk transfer
options.A: AWS DMS replication instance with full load + CDC for the video files
options.B: AWS DataSync agent scheduled hourly over the constrained 500 Mbps link for this workload
options.D: DynamoDB export to point in time as the primary video migration path

questions.question: Partners must upload daily CSV resort files via SFTP into your landing S3 bucket. Managed service?

options.D: AWS Transfer Family (managed SFTP) integrated with the landing S3 bucket
options.A: AWS DMS S3 target endpoint with CDC for partner CSV file uploads for this workload
options.B: AWS DataSync between on-prem NFS shares and the landing S3 bucket for this workload
options.C: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) for partner SFTP file drops

questions.question: night-20-lab exports saa-study-gsa-wiki-views to s3://saa-study-gsa-migration-298043721974/night-20/dynamodb/wiki-views/. Which prerequisite must be true on the table?

options.A: Point-in-time recovery (PITR) enabled — required for DynamoDB export to S3
options.B: DynamoDB global tables with two active Regions already configured for this workload
options.C: AWS Backup vault lock enabled in the same account before export for this workload
options.D: StreamViewType NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES disabled on the wiki views table for this workload

questions.question: Compare AWS DataSync and AWS DMS for the Global Ski Atlas migration portfolio. Which statement is correct?

options.B: DMS migrates databases (full load/CDC); DataSync moves files/objects online
options.A: DataSync replicates database transaction logs; DMS syncs files only for this workload
options.C: Both require a Snowball device for every initial seed transfer job for this workload
options.D: DMS replaces S3 object storage; DataSync replaces Aurora clusters for this workload

questions.question: Same-engine PostgreSQL on RDS must move to Aurora PostgreSQL in the Night 9 VPC. No engine change. Migration type and tool?

options.C: Homogeneous — DMS full load + CDC without SCT schema conversion
options.A: Heterogeneous — requires SCT and Glue ETL only for the move
options.B: Heterogeneous — Snowmobile required to ship WAL files offline
options.D: Homogeneous — Transfer Family SFTP only, with no DMS task for this workload

questions.question: Ops restored an Aurora cluster from a Night 19 AWS Backup recovery point in a staging VPC. Production source still accepts writes until cutover. What closes the gap?

options.D: DMS CDC from the live production source to the restored Aurora target
options.A: Enable DynamoDB PITR on the restored Aurora cluster for catch-up
options.B: CloudTrail data events replay into Aurora to close the write gap
options.C: Route 53 latency routing alone syncs rows between source and target for this workload

questions.question: An exam question mentions variable-duration database migration with no fixed replication instance size. Which DMS option fits?

options.A: DMS Serverless — capacity scales automatically with the migration workload
options.B: DMS on Snowcone only — appliance size replaces replication instances for this workload
options.C: RDS Multi-AZ synchronous standby as the migration compute layer for this workload
options.D: DynamoDB on-demand billing mode for relational DMS replication for this workload

questions.question: You need a portable copy of wiki view counters in S3 for Athena SQL (Night 23 preview), not a new live DynamoDB table. Best export path tonight?

options.B: DynamoDB export to point in time → S3 (night-20-lab staging pattern)
options.A: PITR restore to saa-study-gsa-wiki-views-restored as a live table for this workload
options.C: AWS Backup recovery point mounted as a filesystem for Athena SQL
options.D: DMS homogeneous replication from DynamoDB into ElastiCache Redis

questions.question: night-20-lab creates saa-study-gsa-migration-298043721974 tagged saa-study-migration=night-20. What is this bucket's primary role?

options.C: Encrypted S3 staging for DynamoDB export files and migration artifacts
options.A: Route 53 health check target for DR failover routing policy checks
options.B: CloudTrail log archive that replaces AWS Backup vault storage for this workload
options.D: DMS replication instance root EBS volume snapshot store location for this workload

questions.question: 200 VMware VMs in the resort data center must rehost to EC2 with minimal OS reinstall. Primary AWS service?

options.D: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) for lift-and-shift rehost to EC2
options.A: AWS DMS with heterogeneous endpoints for each VMware guest OS for this workload
options.B: DynamoDB import from S3 as the primary VM rehost mechanism for this workload
options.C: AWS Backup cross-Region copy of AMIs without a migration service for this workload

questions.question: night-20-lab-migration-teardown.ps1 runs after the quiz. What does teardown remove?

options.A: Migration S3 bucket contents and bucket only — Night 18 wiki table remains
options.B: saa-study-gsa-wiki-views and all stream Lambda event source mappings for this workload
options.C: Night 16 Aurora cluster because export referenced resort_stats rows for this workload
options.D: Night 19 backup vault and all recovery points stored in the vault for this workload

questions.question: DMS replication instance sits in a private subnet and must reach saa-study-gsa-aurora on 5432. Which network pattern matches the exam?

options.B: Security group on Aurora allows TCP 5432 from the DMS replication instance SG
options.A: Aurora public accessibility = Yes with 0.0.0.0/0 on the database SG for this workload
options.C: Internet Gateway attached to the private DB subnet route table for this workload
options.D: NAT Gateway attached directly to the Aurora cluster ENI for DMS for this workload

questions.question: Compare DynamoDB export to S3 (Tonight) with DMS targeting DynamoDB. When is native export the better answer?

options.C: Bulk extract to S3 for analytics staging — no DMS replication instance needed
options.A: Continuous live replication with sub-second lag to a second table for this workload
options.B: Heterogeneous Oracle → DynamoDB conversion that still needs SCT for this workload
options.D: On-prem MySQL binlog CDC streaming continuously into DynamoDB for this workload
